narrative.headline: Electrical gremlins and driver-assist glitches top 2019 Odyssey complaints
narrative.summary: From 858 owner complaints filed with NHTSA, the biggest cluster is the electrical system at 23% of reports, closely followed by the forward collision avoidance system at 22%. Together with lane departure (15%), most complaints point at flaky electronics and driver-assist features. Engine reports are fewer (14%) but carry the most safety weight: 4 fires, 2 crashes, and 2 injuries. Watch for dashboard warning lights and unexpected driver-assist behavior on a test drive.
